test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the given figures when placed in the 5th position would continue the series that is established by the first four figures?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0aca9996499992ae9078c9022b162c5d1bee2d4ce25c2158057a3dab2b802f74.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is: **All the three Elements of images are moving in anticlockwise direction.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fe9c230d07932b6c2f7bc671c212ed2083a41206d50a5512960a2cdcf9e75a0.png] 

Here, **image 5** will continue the series.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 2'.***
